# TUROS Developer Docs

> TUROS is the AI-ready data layer for sophisticated investors. Query SEC filing data, macro data, factor data, and repeatable investment analysis through MCP or one API.

Canonical docs: https://www.turos.app/docs
Production API: https://api.secapi.ai
Authentication: `x-api-key` header, not `Authorization: Bearer`
Pricing: free test keys, 100 included live calls, then pay as you go for successful production work

New organizations receive 100 included live calls each UTC calendar month; the allowance resets automatically on the first eligible request in a new month. `api.turos.app` is a future default and must not replace `api.secapi.ai` in production clients until TUROS publishes parity readiness.
